1.label: very_easy
1.summary: Reassemble a two-by-two live scene with one flipped shard and three visible temporal offsets. The sparse scene, slow motion, short hold, and broad phase range make the seam relationships easy to inspect and correct.
1.natural_language: Rebuild the four-channel live scene. Drag shards into place, flip the inverted feed, scrub each temporal offset to master, then hold SCENE SYNC through the short confirmation.

2.label: easy
2.summary: A two-by-three scene introduces six shards, two inverted feeds, and at least four temporal offsets. More moving fragments and decoys require comparing several seams, while the slower world and half-second hold leave time to correct each mismatch.
2.natural_language: Rebuild the six-channel live scene. Restore shard positions and flips, scrub every offset to master, then hold SCENE SYNC until the confirmation completes.

3.label: medium
3.summary: The nine-channel grid returns, with at least six misplaced shards, three inverted feeds, and six temporal offsets. The operator must integrate more seams at once, but phase range, decoy clutter, motion, and the stability hold remain below the original configuration.
3.natural_language: Rebuild the nine-channel live scene in space, orientation, and time. Use the live seams to place and align the feeds, then hold SCENE SYNC through the stability check.

4.label: hard
4.summary: The original configuration: nine live shards with at least eight misplaced positions, three to five 180-degree inversions, at least seven temporal offsets across the -4 to +4 master range, five decoys, original motion, and a 700 ms stable hold.
4.natural_language: Rebuild the live scene in space, orientation, and time. Drag shards into place, flip inverted feeds, scrub every temporal offset to master, then hold SCENE SYNC.

5.label: very_hard
5.summary: A four-by-four field has at least fourteen misplaced shards, five to seven inversions, and at least thirteen temporal offsets over an eleven-tick range. Faster motion and extra decoys make local continuity less diagnostic, so the longer hold must follow a precise whole-scene reconstruction.
5.natural_language: Rebuild the sixteen-channel live scene in space, orientation, and time. Compare its moving seams, repair every shard, and hold SCENE SYNC through the full precision confirmation.

simplified.summary: Select a shard and use the labelled SWAP SELECTED WITH position pad to exchange it with a numbered cell. The existing flip button, temporal scrub, and SYNC hold remain unchanged; the pad replaces direct drag-and-drop only.

full.summary: The historical reference surface: drag a live shard directly onto another shard to exchange their positions, then use the visible selected-shard flip, temporal scrub, and SYNC hold controls.
